articles.title: Mexico City is sinking – and NASA is watching it happen
articles.summary: Mexico City is grappling with a severe environmental crisis, sinking unevenly due to excessive groundwater pumping. articles.title: Taiwan considers resubmitting request for rejected defence budget items
articles.summary: Taiwan's government is reportedly considering resubmitting crucial items cut from its special defence budget back to parliament. Lawmakers had previously removed these items, but the government believes they are vital for national security. This move underscores Taiwan's ongoing efforts to strengthen its defence capabilities amidst regional tensions, highlighting the political challenges in securing critical military funding for strategic assets.

articles.title: Malaysia slams Norway missile export halt, says defence plans put at risk
articles.summary: Malaysia has strongly objected to Norway's unexpected decision to revoke export approvals for a crucial naval strike missile system. Malaysia seeks urgent clarification from Norway on the abrupt change.
